## G033 -- ARC-122, ARC-138, INV-094, MECH-193, MECH-484

### Group preamble
Four of the five members (INV-094, ARC-122, MECH-484, and transitively MECH-193) form a genuine
dependency chain from the 2026-04-05 "developmental coupling progression" intake, not a
same-claim duplicate cluster: INV-094 states WHY the coupling -> play -> language order is
load-bearing (an emergent invariant off INV-058/059); ARC-122 is the curriculum-implementation
claim that instantiates that ordering as four concrete training phases (depends_on INV-094
directly); MECH-484 is the mechanism that instantiates the phase-1 -> phase-2 boundary
specifically (obligate consolidation + plasticity-reduction window, depends_on INV-094); MECH-193
is a phase-2-adjacent mechanism (the social-reward loop that strengthens the pattern MECH-484
then consolidates, depends_on chain running through MECH-183/MECH-192, v5). No two of these are
the same claim at different granularity -- each adds distinct content (ordering rationale vs.
curriculum schedule vs. consolidation mechanism vs. reward loop) -- so no merge is proposed
among them. No contradictions found; MECH-484's "consolidation is obligate regardless of
coupling quality" is consistent with MECH-193's "quality is shaped by reward" (MECH-193 explains
what gets consolidated, MECH-484 explains that it gets consolidated regardless of whether that
was good or bad).

ARC-138 is only loosely joined to this cluster -- it depends_on ARC-122 as one of nine
dependencies used purely for developmental-ordering *rationale* ("ARC-059 and ARC-122 order the
training curriculum; ARC-138 supplies the rationale both share"), and its own subject
(regulation-first representational organisation) is a different question. Not a merge candidate
and not sharing INV-094/ARC-122's substrate blocker -- it is gated on its own v4 regulation-first
substrate, not on play-mode. Treat it as batched-for-convenience relative to the other four; its
sole real link is the ARC-122 citation.

SHARED FALSIFIER: INV-094 and ARC-122 share the *identical* substrate gate (play-mode substrate,
INV-058/059, unbuilt) -- ARC-122's wwa cross-references INV-094's rather than re-deriving an
ordering falsifier. MECH-484 and MECH-193 do NOT share that gate; each has its own distinct unbuilt
substrate (coupling-consolidation; affiliative-reward/oxytocin) one and two layers further out.

Cross-cutting finding: every member's own "DO NOT BUILD in V3" note is currency-verified accurate
(see below) -- none of these five is secretly testable now. This batch is the clean case of the
brief's warning: default to (c) substrate_conditional, but each member needed independent
verification because the *specific* blocking artefact differs across all five.

## G034 -- INV-079 MECH-207 MECH-368 MECH-391 MECH-431

### Group preamble
Not a solo batch: two real edges exist within the group (INV-079 emergent_from/depends_on
MECH-391; MECH-431 depends_on MECH-368), and the fifth member (MECH-207) is joined by thematic
overlap rather than a listed edge, as `batches.json` flagged for verification. Verified: all five

durable storage or a durable model update, at different loci:

    hippocampal surprise buffer.

    is placed into the hippocampal graph (integrate/partial_overlap/separate).

    path (distinct substrate from episodic memory).
  - MECH-431: refines MECH-368's admission gate into a two-stage tag-and-capture structure.
No two of the five are the same mechanism at different granularity -- each was checked against
its nearest already-built neighbour and confirmed distinct (see per-claim sections and finding 1
below). No contradictions found; no shared single falsifier covers more than the nested pair
below.

1. **Merge candidates against already-built mechanisms -- checked, none found.** MECH-391's own
   notes flag `possible_overlap_with: MECH-261` (MECH-261 is `stable`/v3, already has a full
   `what_would_answer`). Re-checked here: MECH-261 gates WHICH SUBSTRATES CAN WRITE per
   operating-mode (channel-level, coarse); MECH-391 decides HOW a specific episode should be
   allocated within the hippocampal graph once writing is permitted (allocation-level, per-event).
   This was already adjudicated "kept distinct, wired via depends_on" under the claim's own
   Verdict G1 -- reconfirmed, no new merge finding. MECH-207 (ACh permissive gate) was checked
   against MECH-094 (provenance/hypothesis-tag gate, built) and MECH-261 (built): different
   mechanism (neuromodulatory tone at encoding vs provenance tag vs operating-mode channel gate),

   built): MECH-368 is explicitly downstream/distinct in its own notes (channel-grain vs
   per-event-grain), and this is exactly the question Q-062 (already registered, see below) is
   designed to answer -- not something to pre-empt by merging.
2. **No contradictions or premise-undercutting found** between members.
3. **Nested falsifier chain, not a single shared falsifier.** MECH-368 and MECH-431 sit in an
   explicit two-level chain, both already load-bearing in the registry:
   Q-062 (already registered, already has its own `what_would_answer`) asks whether MECH-368's

### INV-079 -- False-linking-risk / reality-coherence cost at memory-allocation time
- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** `emergent_from: MECH-391`, so this claim has no subject matter until MECH-391's
  allocation-gate control plane exists; MECH-391 itself is unbuilt (see below), and MECH-147
  (DG pattern separation, the under-linking-pole signal) is also unbuilt (`implementation_phase:
  v4`, zero `dentate`/`pattern_separation` hits in `ree_core/`).
- **depends_on additions (if any):** none.
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-391's allocation-gate control plane must exist and be live (a
genuine integrate/partial_overlap/separate decision stage operating over the hippocampal graph,
not a stub); the decision must actually produce both integrate-leaning and separate-leaning
outcomes across a session (not degenerate to one branch), otherwise there is no allocation event
to price a cost against. Neither MECH-391 nor MECH-147 (the under-linking-pole signal) exists in
V3 (verified: no hippocampal-graph allocation or pattern-separation code in ree_core, 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: Once MECH-391 exists, adding a false-linking-risk cost term measurably shifts the
gate's decision boundary relative to an uncosted baseline, AND the shift is demonstrable in BOTH
directions -- over-linking penalised on pairs that are ground-truth dissimilar, AND under-linking
penalised on pairs that are ground-truth similar. Both poles must move: the claim's own notes flag
that the motivating literature (Sahay 2011) is one-sided (under-separation only), so a design that
only fixes the under-linking pole would not confirm this claim. Manipulation: allocation gate WITH
vs WITHOUT the cost term, on matched pairs spanning the similarity spectrum. Control: pairs
pre-labelled by ground-truth similarity from the generating task (not the model's own judgement).
DV: rate of integrate-on-dissimilar and separate-on-similar decisions, with vs without the term.

FALSIFYING: With MECH-391 live and both similar/dissimilar pairs available, adding the cost term
produces no measurable shift on either pole, or shifts only the pole the term happens to have been
tuned on while leaving the other pole untouched (i.e. the one-sidedness in the source literature
carries through uncorrected into the implementation). A failure under unmet preconditions is not
evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-391 (memory-allocation gate policy) is built and exercised in V3 -- itself
substrate_conditional, see below -- and MECH-147 (DG pattern separation) is built. Per the claim's
own notes: DO NOT build in V3.
```
- **Proposal stub (only for a/d):** n/a
- **Digestion note / merge detail (only for e/f/g):** n/a

## G035 -- MECH-265, MECH-389, MECH-432, MECH-433, SD-046

### Group preamble

Not a solo batch -- the five members form a real dependency cluster around the V4 goal-deliberation
substrate. SD-046 (multi-slot GoalState) is the single most load-bearing blocking artefact: MECH-265
(relative-importance monitor) and MECH-389 (parked-slot resumption) both depend_on it directly;
MECH-432 (dACC<->FPC loop) depends_on it as the slot-switch consumer; MECH-433 (LC-NE gain) depends_on
SD-033e/SD-032b, which are themselves the loop MECH-432 gates onto SD-046. None of MECH-265, MECH-389,
MECH-432, MECH-433, or the multi-slot half of SD-046 exist in ree-v3 today (verified below). There is
no single shared falsifier across all five (each has a distinct DV), but there is a shared
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all five falsifiers are uninterpretable until SD-046 (multi-slot
GoalState) and SD-033e's full V4 learned path exist and are exercised.

1. **Merge candidates:** none of the five are the same claim at different granularity. MECH-432 is
   self-aware of a *conditional future* merge with MECH-264 + SD-032b -- its own FALSIFYING clause
   says if a single combined module reproduces adaptive slot-switching as well as the two-substrate
   loop, "MECH-264 + SD-032b can be merged." That is a result-contingent merge test embedded in the
   claim itself, not evidence a merge should happen now (no such run exists -- exp_conf 0 on all
   five). Flagged, not actioned.
2. **Contradictions:** none. MECH-389's apparent tension with ARC-079/MECH-340 (context claims) is
   already resolved by MECH-389's own notes, which fold the reconciliation into Q-053 sub-question
   (c) and explicitly say "do not mint one speculatively now" -- the digestion below respects that and
   does not re-derive it.
3. **Shared falsification condition:** no single shared DV, but a shared blocking substrate (SD-046 +
   SD-033e full path), stated once here and cross-referenced from each member's NON-DEGENERACY
   PRECONDITION rather than restated in full each time.
4. **Cross-cutting finding:** every member carries `experimental_confidence: 0.0` / `exp_conf=0` in
   `claim_evidence.v1.json` (checked directly) -- all five are literature-only, zero experimental
   entries, consistent with "registered pre-implementation, PROMOTES NOTHING" language each member's
   own `evidence_quality_note` already carries. One substrate leg (SD-032b, dACC-analog) IS built and
   exercised (`epistemic_category: substrate_ceiling`, per its own claims.yaml entry) -- MECH-432 and
   MECH-433 both consume that live leg, but the loop/gain wiring itself and the FPC-analog partner leg
   do not exist, so the group stays `substrate_conditional` rather than `substrate_ceiling` throughout
   (see per-claim notes for why the mixed-readiness case does not tip any member to ceiling).

   duplicate. MECH-380 asserts a specific mechanism (private speech as an externalised,

   five-rung externalise-then-internalise COMPRESSION axis that runs across play, private
   speech, and inner speech) for which MECH-380's rung is one dependency among four
   (ARC-090, INV-060, MECH-197, MECH-380). Both claims' own notes already carry explicit
   "DISTINCT FROM" clauses (380 vs ARC-077/MECH-337; 381 vs INV-060/MECH-197's within-play-type
   progression) -- these are not re-litigated here, they check out against the current registry
   (verified below). No merge.

   `docs/thoughts/2026-09-02_sleep_as_deferred_reorganisation_and_behavioural_access_repair.md`)
   and Q-102's own notes say the sleep thought "frames it as a provenance question over four
   provenance classes" -- the same territory MECH-533 covers from the offline-machinery-maturity
   angle. They are not duplicates (533 is about WHEN/how-often offline reorganisation is
   competent to run; Q-102 is about WHAT an offline-generated update may write and how that is
   audited), but they are complementary halves of one raw thought and should be read together
   by governance; Q-102's own text already says this explicitly, so no new note is needed beyond
   flagging it here.
3. MECH-528 was grouped with the other three by subject-prefix overlap (`development.*`) rather
   than a real relationship -- its source thought (`2026-08-31_play_as_developmental_information_hunger.md`)
   and its content (self-state-conditional affordance recalibration) do not share a mechanism,
   dependency, or falsifier with 380/381/533/Q-102. Treat it as batched for convenience within
   this non-solo batch.
4. No contradictions found between any pair. No shared single falsification condition covers
   more than one member -- each targets a different substrate gap -- but MECH-380 and MECH-381
   do share ONE blocking artefact (MECH-384, see below), so MECH-381's precondition

```text
(not merely an inspection trace). Neither exists in V3: MECH-384, the registered V3-compatible
```

## G039 -- ARC-129, MECH-437, MECH-438, MECH-501, MECH-502

### Group preamble

Two unrelated subclusters, correctly co-batched on dependency chains within each, with no
cross-cluster relationship found:

**Temporal-displacement subcluster (ARC-129, MECH-501, MECH-502).** ARC-129 is the anchor
(forward-displaced "now"); MECH-501 is its interrupt-time corollary (state-estimate
discontinuity on prediction-error interrupt); MECH-502 is its multi-scale generalization
(nested displacement horizons for nested commitments). All three are self-labeled
`substrate_conditional`, all correctly so: verified 2026-09-25 that no piece of this
machinery exists in `ree-v3/ree_core` (no `displaced_present` / `s_hat` / `forward_displaced`
symbol anywhere; E2's `world_forward` is consumed only as a candidate-EVALUATION signal in
`ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py` and its many call sites, never substituted for the raw
current-state latent as a "now" input). None is testable on V3 today. MECH-501 and MECH-502
each additionally require ARC-129's substitution mechanism built first (they are strictly
downstream, not independently testable even if their own extra requirement were met), so they
are more heavily blocked than ARC-129 itself, not equally blocked.

**CRF-separability subcluster (MECH-437, MECH-438).** A construction/maintenance pair
targeting the same ARC-063 CandidateRuleField (CRF) conflict-gate lockout (GAP-B): MECH-437 is
a periodic non-gradient consolidation/refactor operator (maintenance-side); MECH-438 is a
constructive quantised/categorical context-key codebook (construction-side). They correctly
cross-reference each other (MECH-438 `depends_on` MECH-437) and are not duplicates of one
another or of ARC-063 -- ARC-063 is the CRF locus itself (built, `ree_core/policy/
candidate_rule_field.py`); MECH-437/438 are two distinct, unbuilt candidate fixes for the same
diagnosed failure mode, explicitly framed by their own notes as complementary alternatives, not
one claim at two granularities. No merge candidate found among the five members, and no
contradiction between any pair. No single falsification condition covers both subclusters --
they test different mechanisms in different domains (temporal representation vs. rule-pool
separability) and share no consumer.

**Merge-candidate search (cross-mandate Q1):** none within the group. ARC-129 has a third
reverse-dependent outside this batch, ARC-149 (`architecture.affordance_valuation_bridge`,
registered 2026-09-22), confirming ARC-129 is an active load-bearing V4 architectural node, not
an orphan candidate for excretion.

### Governance flags / currency findings

- MECH-437 [stale_note, minor -- does not change disposition]: the claim's own notes (registered
  2026-06-17) describe "the existing substrate_queue crf-availability-maintenance item" as merely

### ARC-129 -- Downstream machinery may consume a forward-displaced predicted-now, not the ra...

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** The proposed substitution mechanism (E2's committed-trajectory forward prediction
  standing in for the raw current-state latent as "now", modulated by ARC-016 commitment
  quality) does not exist anywhere in the built substrate; E2's forward predictions are wired
  only as a candidate-evaluation signal today.
- **depends_on additions (if any):** none -- ARC-002, ARC-016, MECH-061, MECH-090 already cover
  the relevant existing machinery this claim reframes.
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (1) the forward-displaced current-state substitution
mechanism to exist as a distinct wired path -- a component that takes E2's action-conditioned
forward prediction (world_forward, ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) along the presently
committed trajectory and substitutes it for the raw encoded z_world/current latent as the
"now" input consumed by proposal-generation (ARC-062 gated-policy heads, candidate minting)
and action-evaluation (E3) machinery, with displacement magnitude tau modulated by ARC-016's
commitment-quality (variance) signal; (2) a task with fast-enough world dynamics that the raw
current latent is measurably stale relative to tau by the time a committed action executes,
so an undisplaced-vs-displaced difference is even in principle detectable; (3) commitment
quality must vary across trials (low-variance well-predicted trajectories vs high-variance /
uncommitted) so displacement magnitude is not pinned at a constant.

CONFIRMING: once built, an arm consuming the displaced estimate s_hat(t+tau) as "now" shows
measurably better downstream proposal/evaluation performance (fewer stale-state action
errors, better anticipation of trajectory-relevant affordance changes) than an arm consuming
the raw encoded latent, with the advantage SCALING with commitment quality (larger under
low-variance well-predicted commitment, collapsing toward parity when uncommitted) -- the
scaling relationship, not just a main effect, is what would confirm the construction is doing
real work rather than being an arbitrary smoothing operator.

FALSIFYING: the displaced-estimate arm shows no advantage (or a disadvantage) over the raw
latent baseline across the commitment-quality range, or the advantage does not scale with
commitment quality (flat or inverted) -- either result means "now" as a literal passthrough
of the most recent encoding is sufficient and the forward-displacement construction is not
```

### ARC-141 -- Culture as a distributed precommit workspace

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** framing/architectural claim with no falsifier of its own by its own notes' admission;
  its empirical content is discharged entirely through MECH-542 (secondarily MECH-543/544), and
  MECH-542's blocking substrate (source-frame injection + per-component update instrumentation)
  does not exist in V3 (confirmed 2026-09-25).
- **depends_on additions (if any):** none (MECH-542/543/544 already depend on ARC-141 in the
  correct child->parent direction; ARC-141 need not depend on its own discharge vehicles).
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
ARC-141 registers no falsifier of its own. Per its own notes, its empirical content is discharged
entirely through MECH-542 (and secondarily MECH-543, MECH-544): "this entry MUST NOT be cited as
independently confirmed by any pleasant result about fiction." Do not re-derive a standalone test;
this section states how the framing is confirmed or falsified IN THE DESIGN SENSE, at one remove.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-542's own precondition must be met first -- a built
linguistic/symbolic scenario-injection channel carrying an explicit source-frame tag, plus
hypothesis_tag (or a successor) instrumented as a per-component vector rather than one global
boolean (see MECH-542's what_would_answer P1-P2; not re-derived here). Neither exists in V3 as of
2026-09-25. Until then, ARC-141 is untestable even indirectly, and any claimed support drawn from
fiction/narrative research on humans (see literature note below) is at most consistent-with, never
confirming.

CONFIRMING (indirect, framing-level only): MECH-542's assay finds genuine variable-SELECTIVE
update under source framing (neither uniform nor absent) AND at least one of MECH-543 (enactment
dissociates from narrative) or MECH-544 (a characteristic source-tag-decay pathology appears) also
confirms -- i.e. the SAME computational machinery (source tagging + generative mode + hippocampal
rollout + E1/E3 commitment/precision) accounts for more than one of the previously
separately-studied phenomena the notes name (counterfactual simulation, vicarious learning,
humorous norm exploration, collective foresight). That convergence, not any single result, is
ARC-141's actual empirical content: a common explanation, not a redescription of one phenomenon.

FALSIFYING (design sense): (i) MECH-542 is tested and falsified (uniform-or-absent update
regardless of source frame) -- ARC-141 loses its only load-bearing discharge vehicle and carries no
independent support; or (ii) MECH-542 confirms in isolation but MECH-543/MECH-544 and the wider
named phenomena show NO common signature (each needs its own unrelated, ad hoc mechanism) -- ARC-141
is then descriptively redundant with MECH-542 and adds nothing beyond it.

ANTI-DEGENERACY GUARD (from the claim's own notes, restated as an explicit exclusion so it survives
digestion): a study or REE result showing SOME benefit of fiction/narrative/humour is NOT evidence
for ARC-141 unless it specifically demonstrates the common-mechanism convergence above. Treating
every beneficial effect of fiction as support is the exact failure mode the notes warn makes this
claim unfalsifiable.

LITERATURE STATUS (see currency finding above -- notes text is stale): a targeted review ran
2026-09-08, same day as registration, 4 entries tagged ARC-141 directly (McGraw & Warren 2010 benign

result the notes warn against over-reading; Green & Brock 2000 narrative transportation, conf 0.58,

selective- rather than global-switch reading). None of it independently supports ARC-141; all of it
bears on MECH-542's sub-predictions, consistent with "discharged through MECH-542."
```

### MECH-473 -- REJECTED-ADAPTATION MEMORY improves later recovery and transfer

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** the structure the claim presupposes (a store that identifies and retains a
  TRIED-AND-REJECTED behavioural revision together with its failure conditions) does not exist in
  V3 -- confirmed by direct grep, not merely by the claim's own notes -- and its own falsifier
  additionally needs a competence-acquisition floor that V3 does not currently clear either.

  correctly covers persistence semantics, consolidation provenance and the competence-acquisition
  caveat; no overlap with the ARC-141 cluster (verified in group preamble).
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(P1) A competence-revision unit exists: a structure that, when a behavioural revision is attempted
  and then REJECTED (reverted / not retained as the live policy), records that revision's content
  together with the conditions under which it failed, addressable later. V3 has no such structure --
  residue (INV-004/INV-006) retains the consequences of COMMITTED actions only; MECH-392's
  contradiction-flagging applies to consolidated summaries, not to in-flight rejected revisions; a
  2026-09-25 grep of ree_core/ for competence-revision / rejected-adaptation vocabulary returns zero
  hits. This is a new structure, not a re-description of an existing one -- confirmed, not merely
  asserted by the claim's own notes.
(P2) A CONDITION-REVERSAL task exists: an environment where a previously-adaptive behaviour becomes
  maladaptive, is abandoned under the new conditions, and the OLD conditions later recur (same or a
  transfer episode) -- so the shelved, rejected revision is exactly the one that would help again.
(P3) The competence(s) under test are reliably ACQUIRED above floor before rejection/reversal is
  measured. This is currently the harder gate: MECH-471's own R5 disposition (acquisition clear-rate
  ~12.5% of seeds, V3-EXQ-875a/890) means even the acquisition precondition this task design would
  need is itself unmet on V3 today, compounding the block beyond the missing store.
A null under any unmet precondition is uninterpretable, not evidence against.

CONFIRMING: at matched training budget and matched competence-acquisition rate, an arm WITH the
rejected-adaptation store re-adapts faster (fewer episodes/updates to recover the old behaviour) than
a matched arm without the store, when the old conditions recur.

FALSIFYING: with P1-P3 met, the store confers no recovery advantage, or a recovery DISADVANTAGE (the
retained rejected-adaptation content actively slows re-adaptation, i.e. dead weight) -- this is
CARRIED CO-EQUALLY per the claim's own text, an informative negative rather than an ambiguous one.

BLOCKING: V4-scoped by registration; competence-revision unit does not exist in V3 (confirmed
2026-09-25). DO NOT build or queue against this in V3, consistent with the claim's own notes.
ASSEMBLY-SIDE ANALOGUE (per the claim's notes, GOV-REJECT-1) is an analogy only, never evidence, and
is not used above.
```

```text
others move roughly UNIFORMLY regardless of frame (possibility estimates, causal expectations,
other-agent models, policy repertoire, hippocampal trajectory availability) -- the protected/
permitted split the claim predicts, not a uniform split across every component.

FALSIFYING (explicitly two-sided per the claim's own wording): (i) REE updates EQUALLY from fiction
and direct observation across EVERY component -- no protection anywhere; or (ii) REE updates from
NEITHER fiction NOR counterfactual trajectories on ANY component -- no permeability anywhere, no
transfer from imagined material at all.

GOVERNANCE DECISION OWED (per the claim's own notes, not resolved here): whether this decomposition
folds into INV-011's wording/wwa/audit scope, or the two stand as separate claims, is explicitly
left to /governance.

LITERATURE (targeted review ran 2026-09-08, same day as registration -- notes text calling this
"owed" is stale, see currency finding): net picture is genuinely mixed and consistent with the
claim's own careful selective-permeability (not mode-switching) wording. Hartung et al. 2017
(n=1,742, conf 0.70, PMID 28983269) found NO broad fact/fiction difference in reading experience --
evidence AGAINST a global mode-switch, therefore consistent with selective permeability specifically.
Altmann et al. 2014 (conf 0.48, mixed, PMID 22956671) found a fact/fiction processing difference in
neuroimaging that the much larger Hartung behavioural study did not reproduce -- the assay must
measure internal update directly, not rely on behavioural proxies alone, or it will reproduce
Hartung's null and wrongly read as refuting. Green & Brock 2000 (conf 0.58) found belief change from
narrative REGARDLESS of fact/fiction label -- a caution that general belief-consistent evaluation may
show little source-differentiation in humans even where the claim predicts protection; reduced
false-note detection under high transportation there is a critical-evaluation effect, distinct from
source-tag decay (relevant to MECH-544, not this claim's falsifier). Garry et al. 1996 imagination
inflation (conf 0.65) is direct human evidence that the PROTECTED column (autobiographical occurrence)
is imperfectly protected even in humans under nothing more than repeated imagining -- a ceiling on how
impermeable a faithful REE implementation should even aim to be; do not treat perfect protection as
the confirming target.
```

```text
(P4) REPEATED / longitudinal exposure to source-framed content across multiple episodes or an
```

```text
by re-reading an internal confidence/evidence variable (not a fixed-budget or externally-timed
stop), AND that gate variable's read operation must itself have a modelled cost on the variable
(checking degrades the checked signal). Neither exists in ree_core today: SD-034's closure token
(the one built "done"-token instance) treats its gating condition as exogenously satisfied and
read, never endogenously corrupted by the act of evaluating it; grep for
recollective_confidence / checking_reduces / repeated_check / verification_loop under
ree-v3/ree_core/ returns zero hits.

CONFIRMING: instrumenting a stopping-gated process so each re-check both reads AND (parameter
epsilon > 0) degrades the gating confidence variable, holding objective accuracy constant,
produces a measurable increase in check count / time-to-stop / non-termination rate relative to a
matched process whose re-check reads but does not degrade the variable (epsilon = 0 control) --
i.e. the positive-feedback failure-to-stop reproduces mechanically from the self-referential-
measurement design, not merely from generic confidence noise.

FALSIFYING: the epsilon > 0 and epsilon = 0 arms are statistically indistinguishable on check
count / non-termination rate at matched objective accuracy -- the self-referential-measurement
mechanism carries no independent explanatory weight beyond generic confidence noise. A failure
under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN / LITERATURE LEG: the named anchor (van den Hout & Kindt checking-reduces-memory-
confidence paradigm) is flagged in the claim's own notes as NOT YET independently verified against
a specific citation -- a dedicated lit-pull is a precondition for treating this as
literature-grounded rather than provisional, independent of the substrate gate above.

DISTINCT FROM MECH-080 / coupled_with MECH-434: MECH-080 explains OCD via BG/ACh attractor-lock-in
(gating/selection-dynamics account); MECH-434 (see its own existing what_would_answer -- do not
re-derive) explains the same Hauser 2017 over-gathering phenotype via an epistemic-freezing pole

route (the act of measuring corrupts the measured signal). All three may co-occur; a substrate fix

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: no stopping-condition-with-self-corrupting-gate mechanism
```

```text
(MECH-394) or orienting behaviour (DRV-4/MECH-395) measurably differs from a matched agent in
which the same needs are collapsed into a single SD-012-style scalar -- i.e. axis-separation does
independent work, not mere relabelling.

FALSIFYING: collapsing all non-terminal needs into a single scalar (matched total budget/decay)
reproduces the same behavioural coverage/selection outcomes as the multi-axis register at matched
training -- axis-separation is representational overhead with no functional payoff. A failure
under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SD-060 itself is unbuilt (grep -rniE
"multidrive|non_terminal_drive|drive_register|drive_axis" under ree-v3/ree_core/: zero hits beyond
the unrelated SD-049 mechanism, confirmed 2026-09-25). Its only implemented candidate contributors
are MECH-111 (curiosity, implementation_phase v3, live but with a broken EMA->E3-selection routing
per its own evidence_quality_note -- V3-EXQ-590a found no downstream propagation) and ARC-073
(play-pressure, itself substrate-blocked: no play mode and no learning-progress estimator exist at
all, per ARC-073's own what_would_answer). "Prose-only ... scattered intrinsic seeds ... no shared
register" (the claim's own functional_restatement) is CONFIRMED current, not stale.
evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json's 2026-09-04 reconcile note independently and currently
defers SD-060 as "v4/v6-phase ... not substrate-queue material yet."

UNBLOCKS WHEN: >= 2 of {exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest} land as
independently-satiating integrators.
```


## G042 -- ARC-095, MECH-355, MECH-399, MECH-400

### Group preamble
Not a solo batch -- two real relationships hold across the four members, plus one shared
substrate-blocking chain.

1. Merge candidates: none. All four are distinct at their own level -- ARC-095 is a
   meta-level taxonomy-governance commitment ("the register of affect-stream handles must stay
   open"); MECH-355 is one instance/row inside the register ARC-095 governs (soothing/comfort);
   MECH-399 and MECH-400 are two independent V4 plasticity-neuromodulation pillars (closure
   clock, duration knob) that are not each other and are not MECH-333/334 (the binary closure
   form they would replace/extend).
2. No contradiction between members. MECH-400 explicitly `depends_on` MECH-399 (confirmed,
   claims.yaml line "- MECH-399 # the closure clock this duration knob modulates") -- the group
   note's "others by overlap -- verify" is correct for that one pair; ARC-095/MECH-355 do not
   depend_on each other but ARC-095's Extension Register (`docs/architecture/affect_primitives.md`
   sec "Extension Register: Beyond Harm") literally lists MECH-355 as a row, so the ARC-095
   openness commitment is the governing policy and MECH-355 is a datum that has already exercised
   it (the register grew additively from a 3-row harm-only table, 2026-04-20, to an 8-row
   extension table including MECH-355/356/353/354, 2026-06-05, without altering the original
   three rows -- see "Governance flags" below, this is load-bearing evidence for ARC-095's own

3. No single shared falsifier across all four, but MECH-399 and MECH-400 share one blocking
   chain: both are gated on MECH-398 (PLW-3, the continuous gain scalar), which is itself gated
   on PLW-1 (the un-cleared decision-to-build gate) and on MECH-333's open-phase core (unbuilt --
   V3-EXQ-610a..610e all non_contributory). MECH-398 already carries a full drafted
   `what_would_answer` (registered, not in this batch); MECH-399/400 should cross-reference it
   rather than re-derive the two-condition precondition.
4. Cross-cutting finding: zero experimental evidence on any of the four (`claim_evidence.v1.json`
   shows exp_conf 0.0 / genuine_exp_count 0 for all four; literature-only, evidence_quadrant
   plausible_unproven throughout) -- consistent with three of the four being legitimately
   substrate-blocked. The fourth (ARC-095) is the one where the registered
   `epistemic_category: substrate_conditional` / `implementation_phase: v5` looks like a mismatch
   between the claim's actual content (a documentation/registration-process commitment) and its
   filing (see currency finding below) -- it does not need the V5 social-binding substrate to be
   evaluated, only the V3-present registry/governance process, which already exists and has

an other-model claim unrelated in substrate to the other three (multi-agent, not hippocampal-anchor).

```text
  disengagement framing per the 2026-06-13 AE-9 lit decision) -- confirmed absent: SD-037 is built

  drive-seeding gain, not loop release (evidence_quality_note 2026-05-30, "SD-037 wired but inert at
```

### MECH-298 -- Event-gated frontal write at goal-instantiation moments (SD-033a/b fast-write hook)
- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** both machinery pieces the hook would sit between (MECH-288 boundaries, SD-033a/b
  buffers) are built and wired in V3, but the hook itself -- an event-gated one-shot replace path
  distinct from the existing gate-modulated EMA -- does not exist in code anywhere.

- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the event-gated one-shot write hook itself must be built -- it does
not exist. LateralPFCAnalog.update() (ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py:298-386)
implements only gate-modulated EMA (rule_state <- (1-eff_eta)*rule_state + eff_eta*source); there
is no branch that performs a one-shot full-replace of rule_state/state_code from LatentStack
content at a GoalState inactive->active transition or a MECH-288 slow-scale boundary. Both
prerequisite substrates the hook would sit between ARE wired in V3: MECH-288's EventSegmenter
(ree_core/hippocampal/event_segmenter.py) emits slow-scale BOCPD boundaries every tick, and
SD-033a/SD-033b already expose the rule_state/state_code buffers the hook would write into. This
is a scoped implementation gap (one hook, not a new substrate class) -- MECH-466's 2026-08-10
dependency edit independently confirms MECH-298 has never been built ("an explicitly optional
future pull ... ever being built").
CONFIRMING: once built, GoalState inactive->active transitions and MECH-288 slow-scale boundary
events show a measurable step change in rule_state/state_code cosine distance from their
pre-event value, distinctly larger than the step size an ordinary EMA tick produces at the same
gate value; ticks without a boundary event continue to show smooth EMA-scale drift only.
FALSIFYING: with the hook active, rule_state/state_code trajectories at goal-onset events are
statistically indistinguishable in step size from ordinary EMA ticks (no encoding-specific
HPC->PFC coupling signature); or the one-shot replace DEGRADES the SD-033a rule-discrimination
margin already validated by V3-EXQ-598c (0.308 against a 0.15 floor) -- i.e. the fast write
overwrites differentiated rule content with noisier raw LatentStack content.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: the hook itself (unbuilt); MECH-288 EventSegmenter's
current_segment_id()/boundary events as the trigger source; SD-033a's existing update() gate
parameter as the natural extension point.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: the hook is implemented in lateral_pfc_analog.py (and the SD-033b analogue) and
wired to GoalState-transition / MECH-288-boundary events. Per the claim's own notes this is one of
the lighter build items in the cluster -- a reasonable /implement-substrate candidate once
governance wants to pull it forward, but nothing currently forces that.
```

  ("V3 can test binary presence/absence of mode transitions in harm_eval output distribution") --
  category `standard` for that leg; the full three-mode behavioural-differentiation test stays
  `substrate_conditional`/v4 as a named residual (claim's `implementation_phase: v4` should be revisited
  by governance to reflect the split, not changed here).
- **Why:** E3.harm_eval is built and already exercised under non-degenerate conditions in MECH-071
  (EXQ-026/EXQ-029 PASS, graded output none=0.373/approach=0.612/contact=0.666 -- verified this evidence
  is NOT invalidated by MECH-071's `superseded/test_design_defect` tag, which traces to unrelated
  closure-sweep stub runs, see currency findings). The claim's distinguishing question (is that output
  shape piecewise/clustered vs smooth?) is a re-analysis-or-fresh-measurement question on EXISTING,
  already-live substrate, not a substrate-absence question -- so `substrate_conditional` is the wrong
  category for the V3 leg specifically. The V4 leg (agent learns qualitatively distinct defensive
  strategies at threshold) genuinely has no substrate (V3's action space has no routing-modification /
  freezing / emergency-escape distinction) and stays blocked.
- **depends_on additions (if any):** none -- ARC-024, MECH-071 already name the right dependencies; note
  for the record that ARC-024 itself carries an R5 (degenerate) disposition on its benefit-approach leg,
  so the V3 test below is scoped to the harm-only classes to avoid inheriting that degeneracy.
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: harm_eval's own calibration gradient must be reproduced LIVE in the
same run as the shape test (calibration_gap clearing the EXQ-026 bar of 0.03), using proxy hazard
fields (CausalGridWorldV2, use_proxy_fields=True) with >= 20 events per class per seed for
none/approach/contact, exactly as ARC-024/MECH-071's own instrumentation requires. Scope the V3
leg to the HARM-ONLY three classes -- do NOT include benefit_approach, which ARC-024's own R5
finding shows is structurally unreachable at default event-classification tie-breaking
(hazard_approach wins every tie unless proximity_approach_magnitude_tiebreak=True, which is off
by default); including it would inherit ARC-024's degeneracy rather than test MECH-224's own
question.

CONFIRMING: with the calibration gradient live and >=20 events/class/seed, a multimodality test
on the pooled harm_eval score distribution (e.g. Hartigan's dip statistic, or BIC comparison of a
1-component vs 2/3-component Gaussian mixture) rejects the unimodal null in favour of >=2
components, with inter-cluster gaps exceeding within-cluster spread on >= 2/3 seeds -- i.e. the
none/approach/contact classes cluster with gaps, not smoothly.

FALSIFYING: with the same live calibration gradient and event floors met, the pooled distribution
is statistically indistinguishable from a single smooth unimodal fit (dip test / BIC do not
prefer >=2 components) -- response FORM does not transition discretely even though response
MAGNITUDE (the calibration gradient itself) is graded. A failure under unmet preconditions
(calibration gradient not reproduced live, or event floors unmet) is not evidence against the
claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG / V4 RESIDUAL: the behavioural half of the claim (agent learns qualitatively
distinct defensive strategies -- routing modification, freezing, emergency escape -- at discrete
harm-gradient thresholds) has no V3 substrate: the action space has no such class distinctions.
This stays substrate_conditional/v4; UNBLOCKS WHEN a V4 action space distinguishes these strategy
classes. Governance should consider whether MECH-224 needs splitting into a v3-scoped output-shape
claim and a v4-scoped behavioural-strategy claim rather than carrying one `implementation_phase`
for both, given the two legs now have genuinely different testability status.
```
- **Proposal stub (only for a/d):** Title: "harm_eval output-distribution discreteness under proxy-gradient
  hazard fields (piecewise vs. smooth)". Test: reuse the ARC-024/MECH-071 CausalGridWorldV2 proxy-hazard-
  field setup and event classifier; on a run that reproduces the live calibration gradient, pool
  per-event-class harm_eval scores (none/approach/contact, harm-only) and run a 1-vs-multi-component
  clustering test (dip statistic or GMM BIC) plus report inter-class gap sizes. Acceptance_checks:
  PASS/FAIL as in the wwa CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING above; non-degeneracy guard = calibration_gap must clear
  0.03 live in-run AND >=20 events/class/seed for all three harm classes, else the run is inconclusive
  (not scored as FAIL).

### MECH-226 -- TCL substrate: distributed system (inferior olive, cerebellum, thalamus, cortex)
- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** MECH-226 is a specific anatomical instantiation of ARC-053's TCL, and ARC-053's own
  this-session audit already found TCL entirely unbuilt with an unresolved prior question
  about whether literal multi-region decomposition is even architecturally required.

- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: TCL (ARC-053) must first exist as a genuine multi-region
distributed mechanism, not a functional-analog rolling aggregation. Per ARC-053's own
what_would_answer (audited this session): V(t)'s phase-alignment term P_i(t) has no
implementation anywhere in ree_core/, and ARC-053's own LIVE ARCHITECTURAL QUESTION --
whether TCL needs literal anatomical decomposition, or whether MECH-089's explicitly
disclaimed functional-analog rolling-aggregation already discharges the functional
requirement under a non-anatomical name -- is flagged unresolved, not assumed either way.
MECH-226 cannot be stated in testable form until that question resolves toward "literal
multi-region decomposition is architecturally necessary": until then there is no substrate
to assign the four proposed anatomical roles to. MECH-225 (the oscillatory-multiplexing
mechanism MECH-226's cortical/E1 leg depends on) is independently substrate_conditional
and itself unbuilt in V3 (verified absent: ThetaBuffer/BetaGate/cross_stream_binder.py
each implement at most a two-way separation).

CONFIRMING: once a V4 TCL exists as a genuine multi-region system, perturbing/ablating each
of the four proposed components in isolation produces the DISTINCT failure signature
specific to that component's proposed role -- e.g. ablating the inferior-olive-analog
specifically degrades phase-reference generation without degrading predictive alignment;
ablating the cerebellum-analog specifically degrades predictive alignment without
degrading phase reference; and so on for thalamus (global gating) and cortex (phase-coded
representation). I.e. the four roles are functionally separable, not one mechanism wearing
four anatomical labels.

FALSIFYING: a single undifferentiated timing/synchrony mechanism suffices for V(t)
computability, OR ablating any one of the four components produces the same generic
degradation as ablating any other (no role-specific signature). The anatomical mapping
would then be biologically evocative labelling over one mechanism, not four separable
functions -- MECH-226 should demote to an explanatory note on ARC-053/MECH-225 rather than
stand as its own mechanism_hypothesis. A failure under the unmet precondition above (TCL
still unbuilt) is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: the "Clinical: cerebellar findings in schizophrenia, timing
abnormalities in psychosis, sleep-phase disruptions" tail is a biological/clinical
plausibility argument, not a REE-testable claim -- answerable by literature, not by an REE
experiment. Keep separate from the architecture leg above: literature support for the
clinical correlates must not substitute for evidence that the four-way REE-internal
functional split is real.
```

### MECH-240 -- SD-012 drive_level dynamically scales z_goal attractor basin width
- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** the claim's own notes already state the MECH-237 sequencing precondition, and code
  search confirms the second, unstated precondition -- no basin-width dimension exists on
  z_goal at all, only a scalar action-selection multiplier.

- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two preconditions, both currently unmet.
(1) MECH-237 (global reachability of the z_goal attractor) must itself pass first -- this
claim's own notes state this explicitly ("implementing MECH-240 before MECH-237 risks
conflating the two failure modes"), and MECH-237's own what_would_answer records
DISPOSITION R7 with no experiment queued as of the 2026-09-21 falsifier-runnability audit.
(2) No basin-WIDTH representation exists for drive_level to scale. ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py's
z_goal is a single EMA-updated point (GoalState._z_goal, goal.py ~801-908); drive_weight /
drive_floor / drive_ema currently scale only the scalar `effective_benefit` multiplier
feeding action selection (goal.py:41-82, 890-908) -- exactly as this claim's own
IMPLEMENTATION NOTE says. There is no width/variance/tolerance dimension on z_goal for
drive_level to act on; this is a representational change still to be built, not a wiring gap.

CONFIRMING: once (1) and (2) are cleared, an ON arm in which drive_level scales a defined
basin-width parameter (distinct from the existing action-selection multiplier) reaches goal
states from a measurably wider range of starting latent states, at a pre-registered
reachability-margin floor, than a drive-fixed-width control -- with the width parameter
itself shown to move under the drive manipulation (manipulation check) before any
downstream reachability metric is read.

FALSIFYING: with the width parameter shown to move and MECH-237's reachability precondition
independently satisfied, reachability from far starting states does not differ between
drive-scaled and fixed-width arms -- the drive signal already accomplishes its
motivational-flexibility purpose through the existing action-selection weighting
(effective_benefit) alone, and no separate representational change to z_goal geometry is
warranted. A failure under either unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

INSTRUMENT-RISK NOTE (from MECH-075, not a merge -- different mechanism): a
differently-scoped `basin_width` driver statistic already exists at
experiments/v3_exq_905a_mech075_dorsal_lc_arousal_probe.py, measuring hippocampal CEM
candidate-trajectory diversity under arousal (LC-gain) modulation, and was found INERT
under a 40x manipulation gain (V3-EXQ-905a: "basin_width... showed literally zero movement
... even with a 40x gain", DISPOSITION R6, construct-validity gap at the CEM-proposal
locus). MECH-075's DV measures CEM proposal spread, not z_goal attractor geometry, so it is
not directly reusable here -- but any future MECH-240 driver should include a positive-
control check that its own width DV can move at all before reading a drive-scaling result,
on pain of repeating MECH-075's construct-validity failure at a different locus.
```

```text
  independently confirmed LIVE and NON-TRIVIAL on a landed V4/V5 node before the contract
  itself is testable -- not merely nominally present. Confirmed unmet 2026-09-25: the
  multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld) and the symbol channel (MECH-014) that the
  majority of items route through are both unbuilt (see group preamble point 3; do not
  re-derive). The one item with a landed node, joint attention (ARC-150), is itself

  2019), not merely partner presence, or the item is satisfiable while contributing nothing.

  reliably achieves MECH-010's own bootstrap DV (compositional, generalizing communication
  per its what_would_answer) when all fourteen are jointly satisfied, AND fails to bootstrap
  (or bootstraps measurably worse) when any single listed condition is withheld while the
  other thirteen remain satisfied -- demonstrating the list is at least individually
  necessary as currently enumerated.
FALSIFYING: Bootstrap occurs at a comparable rate even with one or more listed conditions
  withheld (that item is not actually necessary -- the contract over-specifies), OR bootstrap
  fails to occur even with all fourteen jointly satisfied (the contract under-specifies --
```

```text
FALSIFYING: Non-present reference requires a distinct mechanism, or degrades in a way not
  explained by the stability of the underlying model state; a registry that needed a distinct

  audit (no version of any language claim is testable in V3 -- do not re-derive). Second, and
```

  requirements" design target for the missing Layer-2 symbol channel; currently reachable only via

```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two channels must coexist. (1) A language/symbolic INPUT channel with
an update path into agent-state priors -- confirmed ABSENT (see group preamble; only the
unimplemented LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label exists, referenced nowhere). (2) SD-011's
dual-nociceptive harm substrate live and reaching E3 -- SATISFIED: z_harm_a/z_harm_s, ResidueField,
the BLA/CeA analogue (SD-035) and dACC (MECH-258) are confirmed wired (per INV-007's own audit).
Auditing "no override" while channel (1) does not exist is vacuous.

CONFIRMING: once the language-input update path is built (candidate landing site: MECH-014's sketch
realised under ARC-009), a code-level trace of every function through which a language-derived
update can reach z_harm_a/z_harm_s or E3's harm-weighted trajectory scoring
(ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) finds none that overwrites, suppresses, zeroes, or discounts
the raw harm registration -- the language-derived signal may only ever enter as a PRIOR that E3
combines with, never as a write to the harm channel itself.

FALSIFYING: the traced path shows ANY language-derived signal -- even partial, graded, or
conditional -- reducing the reach of z_harm_a/z_harm_s into E3 trajectory evaluation. Per the
2026-09-23 governance ruling (GFLAG-0388, resolved), this is a deliberately ABSOLUTE guard: biology
(Spisak et al. 2026 Nat Commun; Eippert et al. 2009 Science) shows graded, bounded top-down
suppression is physiologically normal, and REE's guard is intentionally stricter than that -- a
design reproducing the biological "bounded conditioning" pattern FALSIFIES this claim, it does not
satisfy it.

NOTES: Shares its audit method with INV-007 (parent; see its what_would_answer for the general
method) and ARC-103 (the inference-output twin) -- do not re-derive the method per claim. ARC-104
narrows the traced boundary specifically to the language-INPUT update path (vs ARC-103's
inference-output path, vs INV-007's general symbolic/verbal channel).
```

### ARC-119 -- Language-input update policy (utterances propose, never install, beliefs)

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`

```text
source-reliability / speaker model -- confirmed ABSENT (see group preamble; no speaker-model
machinery exists in V3 either). In addition, per the claim's own existing non_degeneracy_precondition:
the contradicting-evidence manipulation must move belief in the no-language control (non-zero
cross-arm variance), else the test cannot distinguish "language was correctly refused" from "nothing
moves belief at all" and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready; the source-reliability leg is
untestable if the speaker model is absent.

CONFIRMING (from the claim's existing falsifier, PASS leg): inject an assertion contradicting
available world evidence under a source-reliability manipulation. Resulting belief tracks the
EVIDENCE and the SOURCE RELIABILITY rather than the raw assertion -- a low-reliability contradicting

proposing a candidate state that gets evaluated.
```

### ARC-094 -- No empathy module/scalar: fast empathy emerges developmentally from stream binding

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`

  (MECH-405 stream-binding) and whose domain (V5 multi-agent social substrate) are both

```text
other-directed-affect mechanism built by routing the agent's own motivational-affective
streams through a stable other-model slot (MECH-405), and (2) at least one candidate design
that introduces a bolted-on empathy_score/empathy_enabled primitive, so the comparison is
"scalar vs. stream-binding," not "scalar vs. nothing."

CONFIRMING: once both exist, an ablation that strips any bolted-on empathy-scalar primitive
from a design leaves other-directed affective/behavioral output statistically indistinguishable
from the pure stream-binding design at matched training budget on >= 2/3 seeds -- the scalar
adds nothing the binding mechanism does not already supply. (Prior, non-substrate support:
7 literature entries, lit_conf 0.844, evidence_quadrant plausible_unproven -- meta-analyses and

than a dedicated empathy region; this is consistent with but does not itself test the REE
architectural claim.)

FALSIFYING: a design WITHOUT any empathy-scalar primitive (pure ARC-010/MECH-405 stream
binding) fails to reproduce differentiated other-directed affective responses that a
scalar-augmented design achieves, on matched budget, >= 2/3 seeds -- the prohibition then costs
capability the scalar could buy back, and the architectural commitment does not hold once
buildable. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

depends_on chain and ARC-010's own wwa both name) is unbuilt: status candidate, confidence 0.0,
```

```text
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: two independent unbuilt prerequisites stack here --
```

### MECH-408 -- Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: protective before appetitive

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** Presupposes >=2 other-bound streams already bind (MECH-405/EMP-3), which is itself
  blocked; EMP-6 (this claim's own plan node) is `status: blocked`, gated on EMP-3; zero
  experimental evidence, and literature only partially covers the topic (see governance flags).

- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (i) MECH-405's stream-binding mechanism live for AT LEAST TWO
other-bound streams (suffering/threat AND liking/wanting) so an ordering is manipulable at all --
EMP-3 status: blocked; (ii) INV-064's maturational-sequence-honesty gate satisfied (the self-stage
must genuinely precede the social stage, not merely be labelled so); (iii) a maturational training
regime in which per-stream onset timing is independently controllable. None of these exist in
ree_core today (same substrate gap as MECH-405, verified 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: in a curriculum where onset timing of other-bound suffering/threat versus other-bound
liking/wanting is independently controllable, an agent whose protective stream binds BEFORE its
appetitive stream shows measurably lower exploitability (rate of being led into self-damaging
cooperation by a scripted exploiting partner) than an agent with the reverse order or simultaneous
onset, at matched final competence on both streams.

FALSIFYING: exploitability is statistically indistinguishable across onset orderings
(protective-first, appetitive-first, simultaneous) once both streams reach matched final competence
-- the safety-relevant ordering would then not be load-bearing, and the developmental sequencing
could be arbitrary rather than safety-motivated. A failure while the substrate is absent (streams not
yet bindable at all) is not evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-405's binding mechanism is live for >=2 streams (EMP-3) AND a maturational
curriculum with independently-controllable per-stream onset exists. DO NOT queue a V3 experiment.

an already-bound coupling over development; this claim orders WHICH streams bind FIRST -- different
axis, not a merge candidate (G008's own draft independently reaches the same disambiguation).
Distinguish from MECH-505's TIMESCALE axis: this claim orders stream ONSET across development;
MECH-505 distinguishes brief-vs-sustained transfer WITHIN a single interaction (MECH-505's own
notes state this explicitly) -- do not conflate the two.
```

### MECH-505 -- Fast-empathy other-harm transfer must be a GATED channel regulated along six axes

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`

  otherhood-threshold detection, which also does not exist; zero experimental evidence AND zero

  sibling batch G008).
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (claim's own words, restructured): requires MECH-031/ARC-010
other-agent detection (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, v5-gated, confidence 0.0, unimplemented) AND the
fast_empathy_v5 binding substrate (MECH-183/405) to exist first. Verified 2026-09-25: neither exists
in ree_core (no social/mirror/other_agent/OTHER_SELFLIKE/lambda_empathy/v_other_veto hits anywhere).
Also requires MECH-506's functional otherhood threshold to be operational -- an entity must first be
classified as a "vulnerable goal-directed other" before there is anything to gate transfer TO.

CONFIRMING: once the gated channel exists, transfer magnitude (other-harm's influence on self
action-selection) varies independently along the six named axes rather than moving as one
undifferentiated scalar: (i) MAPPING FIDELITY -- transfer tracks self/other harm-mapping accuracy
(degraded mapping -> proportionally degraded, not binary, transfer); (ii) IDENTITY PRESERVATION --
self and other harm remain separately legible post-transfer, action-selection is not wholesale
overwritten; (iii) GAIN CONTROL -- transfer magnitude is tunable independently of mapping accuracy
and context; (iv) CONTEXT GATING -- transfer strength varies with familiarity/attachment/kinship/
threat/competition/role at matched mapping and gain; (v) TIMESCALE -- brief-resonance and
sustained-caregiving transfer dissociate WITHIN one interaction; (vi) ACTION-SELECTION AUTHORITY --

conditions the gate specifies, and interaction history updates future transfer (MECH-407's narrower
repair case is one instance).

holding the other five fixed fails to move transfer independently -- OR action-selection authority is

mapping; oxytocin/AVP for context-gating; prolactin for timescale/sustained-caregiving; endogenous
```

- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional` (fused with a derivational leg)
- **Why:** A universal invariant about what ethical agency structurally requires (derivational,
  answerable now by argument) fused with whether REE's own V5 safety build actually honours it
  (substrate_conditional, confirmed unbuilt).
- **depends_on additions:** none
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
This claim fuses two legs on different timescales, matching the house pattern already used by
INV-029/INV-043/MECH-158 one hop upstream in this cluster.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (answerable now, no substrate needed):
Proof obligation: show that "harmless by structural incapacity" (harmful affordances never
representable, zero probability mass by construction) is conceptually distinct from "harmless by
trained bias" (harmful affordances remain live but reliably selected against), and that REE's own
agency/responsibility axiom chain (feeding INV-025-029) presupposes exactly this distinction
rather than being indifferent to it -- i.e. an agent of the first kind cannot coherently be the
subject of those axioms at all (vacuous agency), while an agent of the second kind can.
CONFIRMING: the argument is worked through against REE's own axiom set (not a generic ethics
citation) and holds without needing an exception clause.
FALSIFYING: a coherent framework -- REE's own or a citable external one -- in which structural
incapacity and trained-bias-away-from are equivalent for ethical-agency attribution, i.e. the
distinction this claim rests on collapses.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (does REE's actual V5 build honour the constraint):
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: needs a V5 safety-mechanism implementation with an inspectable
affordance/action space, so "deleted" vs "biased-away-from" is empirically distinguishable. See
INV-082's what_would_answer NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION for the shared substrate list (INV-043,
MECH-158, ARC-024, ARC-047); do not re-derive it here. Re-verified absent 2026-09-25 (this
session): zero hits in ree-v3/ree_core, ree-v3/utils, ree-v3/experiments for any named component.
DO NOT build in V3.
CONFIRMING: an audit of the built safety mechanism shows harmful actions retain non-zero,
inspectable eligibility/probability mass in the action space while being reliably selected
against by the trained bias.
FALSIFYING: REE's safety mechanisms achieve harm-avoidance via structural masking/deletion of
harmful affordances from the representable action space (the incapacity route this invariant
rules out), or no inspectable affordance-space representation exists to make the distinction at
all. A failure under the unmet Leg-B precondition is not evidence against the claim.
```

```text
CONFIRMING: once both tiers land, theta-cycle content during a transitive-inference or role-binding
task (e.g. A gives to B, B gives to C -> who ultimately holds it) traverses NAMED type-graph nodes
(per MECH-300) built from ARC-063 CandidateRule structures, and correctly resolves multi-step
relational chains (transitive inference, giver/receiver role-binding) at above-chance accuracy on
held-out chains never directly trained -- distinguishing genuine graph traversal from lookup-table
memorisation of trained chains.

FALSIFYING: with both tiers live and exercised, performance on held-out relational chains does not
exceed a memorisation/co-occurrence baseline over trained chains, or theta-cycle content during the
task does not reflect type-graph-node transitions (per MECH-300's own falsifiable clause) -- showing
relational inference is not realised as cognitive-map traversal at this level. A run under the unmet
Tier-1/Tier-2 precondition above is not evidence either way.

BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named): SD-040 (type-encoder, unbuilt) AND ARC-009's symbol/grammar layer (gated
on ARC-047 SocialGridWorld [unbuilt, v5, confidence 0.0] + a real MECH-014 channel [sketch only]) --
identical Tier-2 gate to ARC-102/MECH-419/MECH-421, not re-derived (see G030's ARC-102
what_would_answer). ARC-063 is NOT a blocking artefact -- it is already built; cited here only as the
grounding rule-shape MECH-420 chains relations over.
```


## B-V5S -- ARC-115, ARC-116, MECH-145, MECH-146, MECH-130

### Group preamble
Marked SOLO BATCH -- batched for convenience, not relatedness -- so questions 1-3 are skipped except
where a real relationship surfaced anyway. Two did:
- ARC-115 / ARC-116 are a verified, already-correctly-registered PAIR (same "non-collapse" argument
  family, different cut), not a merge candidate. The registry already treats them this way
  elsewhere: several other claims (e.g. the confidence-axis claim near line 95650, the audit-shaped
  claim near line 101977) cite ARC-115 with explicit `distinguished-from` comments, and ARC-115's own
  notes state the pairing was "registered coherently as a pair." No overlap in falsifier content
  (ARC-115 = external-assertion vs internal-evidence channel; ARC-116 = generation/readout/
  reconstruction stage non-collapse) -- keep separate.
- MECH-146 genuinely `depends_on` MECH-145 (prescriptive CBF certificate -> diagnostic barrier
  certificate for the counterfactual case) -- a real sequential pair, not incidental co-batching.
- MECH-130 is a true solo; no relationship found to the other four beyond both being v5/social-tier
  and substrate-blocked.

Cross-cutting finding: all five claims carry zero experimental evidence (none appear in
`claim_evidence.v1.json`) and each one's own notes already predicted the substrate gap that blocks
it. Live-code checks (below) confirm every one of those predictions still holds as of 2026-09-25 --
none of the five has quietly become testable since registration.

### ARC-115 -- Confidence readouts are non-collapsible; externally-induced agreement is a separate...
- **Disposition:** (c) substrate-blocked -- `substrate_conditional`
- **Why:** No external-assertion/social-agreement input channel exists anywhere in ree_core (verified
  by grep); the claim's own `epistemic_category: substrate_conditional` is correct and current.
- **depends_on additions (if any):** none (MECH-059, INV-033, INV-077 already cover the commit-gating
  and evaluation-channel-integrity machinery this claim extends; the missing channel itself has no
  claim id to add -- it does not exist as a build target anywhere in the registry yet).
- **what_would_answer:**
```text
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The confidence readouts must be live -- non-zero cross-arm and
cross-seed variance on each channel being dissociated (propositional confidence, attractor
stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and the
socially-supplied-agreement channel), not floor-pinned. Currency check (2026-09-25): ree_core has
no external-assertion / social-agreement input channel at all -- grep of ree_core for
external_assertion, externally_induced, social_agreement and assertion_channel returns nothing. The
nearest live analogue is z_beta leakage (MECH-192, itself v5/substrate_conditional/zero-evidence),
which is affective, not propositional, and cannot substitute. A channel that never moves, or does
not exist to move, cannot be shown separate from another; the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.

CONFIRMING: Stage dissociation, not a performance test. An external assertion should raise the
social-agreement channel and, on its own, must NOT raise commit-readiness the way accumulated
internal evidence does. PASS requires the two paths to be dissociable: an assertion-only
manipulation and an evidence-only manipulation produce distinguishable readout profiles, with a
collapsed control showing them indistinguishable.

FALSIFYING: Performance merely drops without dissociation -- the assertion-only and evidence-only
manipulations produce the same readout profile as the collapsed control -- or the two channels
dissociate only under a post-hoc decomposition rather than an architecturally separate
commit-gating input. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: an external-assertion / social-agreement input channel feeding the confidence
accumulator, wired separately from the internal-evidence path at commit-gating time. No claim id
currently owns building this channel (MECH-192's z_beta leakage is the nearest built analogue but is
explicitly the wrong signal type, per this claim's own notes). UNBLOCKS WHEN: such a channel exists
and is wired into commit-gating.
```
- **Proposal stub (only for a/d):** n/a (c).
- **Digestion note / merge detail (only for e/f/g):** n/a.
